title: Midnight Deploy · Ep 1: The Expired Token
caption:
2:59 AM. 10,000 users logged out at once. The bug? One line.

JWT "exp" is in seconds. Date.now() is in milliseconds. Compare them directly and every token looks expired.

Fix: token.exp * 1000 < Date.now()

Episode 1 of Midnight Deploy. Follow for Episode 2: The Cache That Lied.
